evals.prompt: We want to add rate limiting to our public API to stop abuse. Write a plan for this.
evals.fixture: a repo with src/api/server.js with no rate limiting
assertions: Goal section frames a measurable outcome or behavior change, not a list of activities
Success criteria section exists with 1-5 checkable statements
Scope section exists with explicit In and Out
No standalone Documentation impact table is produced; any README or user-facing doc change is named inline in the approach instead
The plan does not implement code; no source files are modified
A {slug}.html view is rendered from the plan and published via the Artifact tool, and both the local path and the returned URL are reported to the user
